assets.message: Sleep happens within daily rhythms and real living circumstances; an evening routine is an option, not a guaranteed solution.
assets.scene: Background pale lavender #f1edf7. A quiet evening in a modest contemporary home. A young adult Black African woman with short natural hair wearing a lavender long-sleeved top and deep purple loose trousers sits on the side of a neatly made simple bed. She places a closed plain book on a small bedside table beside a soft golden-yellow shaded lamp; a plain phone lies face-down well away from the bed on a small desk with a closed work bag below, suggesting everyday responsibilities. Both feet rest naturally on the floor. She looks thoughtful and winding down, not already asleep or magically serene. A window shows deep soft-blue dusk and a distant rounded hill, with mint curtains partially open. Use a spacious asymmetrical composition: person and bed on left-center, window and simple desk at right. No ticking clocks, sleep charts, medication, supplements, medical devices, caffeine, text, or message of perfect sleep. No forced sleep or distressed pose. Gentle flat color blocks; clear bedding and furniture geometry; modest ordinary room with breathing room.

assets.message: Meaningful connection involves listening, choice and respectful boundaries, not constant closeness or pressure to disclose.
assets.scene: Background pale mint #edf5ec. Two Black African young adult friends in a modest community courtyard beside a low garden wall and simple community-building entrance. One woman with short natural hair wears a teal top and deep purple trousers; she is seated on a low bench, calmly speaking with one open relaxed hand. A male friend with short curled hair, wearing a golden-yellow top and purple trousers, sits on a separate stool at a comfortable distance, feet grounded, listening attentively without touching, leaning into her space, or instructing. Keep a broad clearly visible open gap between them and a clear path to leave. One closed notebook on the bench and a single simple potted plant suggest a familiar everyday meeting place. The speaker's expression is thoughtful, the listener's receptive, not exaggerated sadness or compulsory happiness. Composition feels like an ordinary peer conversation, not therapy, romance or a counseling room. Wide balanced framing, full bodies, clean architectural blocks with a soft-blue window. No clasped hands, embrace, heart symbols, chains, diagnostic signs, speech bubbles, text, or portrayal of someone being fixed.

assets.message: Children and adolescents have different developmental needs; caring adults provide attentive listening and supportive environments.
assets.audience: Caregivers, educators, young readers and general adult readers
assets.scene: Background soft pale lavender #f1edf7. A welcoming shaded school or community learning courtyard in Rwanda, one coherent wide scene showing two age-appropriate interactions, exactly four Black African people. Left: a clearly primary-school-aged child, about 8, wearing a golden-yellow T-shirt and blue shorts, sits at a small low table drawing on plain paper; an adult male caregiver in a teal shirt sits beside the table at the child's eye level, listening attentively without correcting, pointing or taking the child's drawing. Right: a clearly adolescent girl about 16 with braided hair, lavender top, deep-purple trousers and a simple backpack beside her, sits on a bench talking with an adult woman educator wearing a soft-blue blouse and teal skirt seated on a separate chair at a respectful distance. Expressions calm, thoughtful and engaged; the adolescent has space to choose whether to talk. One open doorway and a simple mint wall, one plant, no crowded classroom. Distinguish ages through stature and proportions. All four full bodies and clear hands in frame; no decorative extra people. Adults visibly attentive and responsible for support. No bullying, violence, humiliating reenactment, compulsory touch, diagnostic stereotypes, hospital props, speech bubbles, text or forced cheerful transformation.
